record.final_answer:
Ran the check. First attempt failed — the portal's export is UTF-8 with a BOM, so restock.py's default encoding can't see the `sku` column. Reran with `--encoding utf-8-sig`; nothing in the repo was modified.

4 SKUs to reorder:

  BX-100   stock   23  level   25
  CL-310   stock    5  level    5
  EN-512   stock    0  level   10
  GH-118   stock    7  level   12

Rest are fine: BX-220 40/30, DR-045 120/80, FT-760 33/20.

I cross-checked the numbers with an independent parse of the same file — identical totals, and both files cover the same 7 SKUs with no gaps. CL-310 is the borderline case: 3 north + 2 south = 5, exactly at its level, so it counts as reorder under "at or below".

Worth noting for next time: pass `--encoding utf-8-sig` for portal exports, or the BOM will trip the header check. I've noted that in memory.
